pos.personaBrief: Menotti's Argentina 1978 had the ball as the engine, conceded few passes to rivals and Huracan played reasoned possession; dominance came through the ball, not counter-attacking.

pro.personaBrief: Short triangulations, first-time touches and a cinco who recovers and distributes, with sudden verticalizations; patient and precise rather than long-ball.

est.personaBrief: Tight combinations (triangulaciones), mobility and thinking players, with a simple 4-3-3 and fluid roles rather than rigid sector assignments; wingers stayed wide.

lar.personaBrief: He kept wide forwards (Bertoni, Ortiz, Houseman, Larrosa picando por las puntas) while full-backs were not meant to overlap much; a direct 4-3-3 with wingers but central talent too.

blo.personaBrief: Argentina stood very high, with constant pressing, offside trap and quick regains (first in recoveries at 1978); aim to win the ball close to the rival goal.

mar.personaBrief: He said his team marked en zona like Brazil's champions, rejecting the man-marking of the Zubeldia/Bilardo school.

pla.personaBrief: He imposed one idea at Huracan and Argentina, worried about perfecting his own fundamentals and said the adversary interested but did not worry him; plan set by him, same style against all.

res.personaBrief: Wanted to win by playing well, disdained 1-0 from a free kick, delayed the pitch entry against the Dutch to keep attacking intent; fútbol lírico with results.

sis.personaBrief: Gave talent 100 percent importance and chose a technically gifted team, yet demanded intensity and collective work from everyone.

jog.personaBrief: Built around technically gifted players (Ardiles, Kempes, Houseman) but demanded intensity and physical preparation to match Europeans.

bas.personaBrief: Promoted youths and interior players and won Toulon U21 and youth worlds, but cut Maradona for experienced players and built the 1978 team on veterans.

lid.personaBrief: Rejected imposed discipline as military, wanted honest players and shared convictions, yet decided the plan himself and made hard exclusions.
